description: This file defines data models, types, and classes related to agents, including their capabilities, security schemes, skills, interfaces, and response models, for a software project involving agent management and messaging.

classes.name: AgentProvider
classes.description: Represents the service provider of an agent.

classes.name: AgentExtension
classes.description: A declaration of a protocol extension supported by an Agent.

classes.name: AgentCapabilities
classes.description: Defines optional capabilities supported by an agent.

classes.name: SecuritySchemeBase
classes.description: Base properties shared by all security scheme objects.

classes.name: APIKeySecurityScheme
classes.description: Defines a security scheme using an API key.

classes.name: HTTPAuthSecurityScheme
classes.description: Defines a security scheme using HTTP authentication.

classes.name: MutualTLSSecurityScheme
classes.description: Defines a security scheme using mTLS authentication.

classes.name: OAuthFlows
classes.description: Defines the configuration for the supported OAuth 2.0 flows.

classes.name: OAuth2SecurityScheme
classes.description: Defines a security scheme using OAuth 2.0.

classes.name: OpenIdConnectSecurityScheme
classes.description: Defines a security scheme using OpenID Connect.

classes.name: AgentSkill
classes.description: Represents a distinct capability or function that an agent can perform.

classes.name: AgentInterface
classes.description: Declares a combination of a target URL and a transport protocol.

classes.name: AgentCardSignature
classes.description: Represents a JWS signature of an AgentCard.

classes.name: AgentCard
classes.description: The AgentCard is a self-describing manifest for an agent, providing metadata including identity, capabilities, skills, communication methods, and security requirements.

classes.name: AugmentedAgentCard
classes.description: An extension of AgentCard with an 'is_public' attribute.

classes.name: AgentConfig
classes.description: Configuration model for an agent, including name, card parameters, and litellm parameters.

classes.name: PatchAgentRequest
classes.description: Model for patching/updating agent information.

classes.name: AgentResponse
classes.description: Response model for agent data, including IDs, timestamps, and metadata.

classes.name: ListAgentsResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of agents.

classes.name: AgentMakePublicResponse
classes.description: Response model for making an agent public, including message, groups, and updater info.

classes.name: MakeAgentsPublicRequest
classes.description: Request model for setting agents as public.

classes.name: LiteLLMSendMessageResponse
classes.description: Wrapper for A2A SendMessageResponse with additional tracking and logging features.

methods.name: from_a2a_response
methods.description: Creates a LiteLLMSendMessageResponse from an A2A SDK SendMessageResponse.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Creates a LiteLLMSendMessageResponse from a dictionary.
